title: A simple calendar of Moon phases
description: The phase, the date and your own notes are available without studying a large map.

blocks.text: Sometimes what is needed is a short answer about one chosen day. Extra sections get in the way of exactly that simple action.

quote.text: One of the Best Apps I have used especially for Hunting/Fishing. I pay close attention to the Moon phase. It works perfectly & is extremely detailed!

blocks.text: Build a clear first screen and a way to move between dates. Keep personal plans and observations alongside, as separate entries.
Do not present calendar notes as proof that the phases affect the catch or the harvest. Astronomical data and interpretations have to stay distinct.
